title: Environmental volunteering
source_note: Original ForLanguage content. User-provided recent-review notes were used only as topic-frequency signals. British Council materials were used only to verify public task format and word limits.

tasks.prompt: You have joined a local environmental volunteer group. Reply briefly to five member messages.
tasks.review_note: Original ForLanguage task authored from recurring practice/review themes and checked against the public Aptis ESOL General Writing format; no official or recalled prompt copied verbatim.
questions: Which environmental issue interests you most?
Which weekend day are you usually free?
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?
What item would you bring to a clean-up event?

tasks.prompt: The group is choosing its next project. Write a short message describing one environmental activity that would benefit the neighbourhood.
tasks.review_note: Original ForLanguage task authored from recurring practice/review themes and checked against the public Aptis ESOL General Writing format; no official or recalled prompt copied verbatim.

tasks.prompt: Volunteers are discussing how to increase participation.
tasks.review_note: Original ForLanguage task authored from recurring practice/review themes and checked against the public Aptis ESOL General Writing format; no official or recalled prompt copied verbatim.
questions: Which project would attract more families?
How could the group encourage people to volunteer regularly?
Should local businesses support volunteer projects? How?

tasks.prompt: The group announces that a planned park clean-up has been moved to a weekday and volunteers must now bring their own equipment. Write to a friend explaining your reaction and what you think should be suggested.
